    The critical diagrams of type D̃ (von Höhne 1988, Theorem 2.1) #

    The critical diagrams of type D̃_n (von Höhne, Fig. 3) form one family. Its points are an induced path p 0, …, p (M - 1) of full edges and two more points s, t, with attachment positions i < j < M:

    • s is joined to p (i + 1); if i ≥ 1 also to p 0, and by a broken edge to p i;
    • t is joined to p (j - 1); if j + 2 ≤ M also to p (M - 1), and by a broken edge to p j;
    • s and t are joined if j = i + 1;
    • the radical vector is 2 on p k for i < k < j and 1 elsewhere.

    i = 0 is a fork end (s and p 0 are two leaves at p 1), i ≥ 1 a cycle end s, p 0, …, p i closed by a broken edge. We record the coefficients on the model points Pt (sc, sy) and show that the family is closed under deflation (sc_deflA, sc_deflB, and the reflection sc_refl).
